title: Access Patterns
prompt: Implement `bigger_of(const int* a, const int* b)` returning the pointed-to value that is larger, or 0 when either pointer is null; and `swap_through(int& a, int& b)` swapping through references.

tests.name: both valid
tests.hint: Dereference and compare when both are non-null.

tests.name: null tolerated
tests.hint: Null pointers are legal input: return 0, never dereference.

tests.name: swap
tests.code: int a = 1, b = 2; swap_through(a, b); CHECK_EQ(a, 2); CHECK_EQ(b, 1);
